QuestInfo.0: You're really starting to look like a Thief. #b#p1052001##k wants to help you with one last training session.
QuestInfo.1: #p1052001# wants you to slay #r10 #o2300100#s#k as a test. #o2300100#s are one of the strongest monsters around #m103000000#, so you have to stay alert. \n\n#o2300100# #r#a21431##k
QuestInfo.2: You destroyed 10 #o2300100#s. It wasn't easy, but you feel like you're well on your way to becoming an amazing Thief.

0.0: 애송이 도적 친구. 지금까지 수련을 잘 따라와줬네. 여전히 허술한 구석이 있지만 그래도 어느 정도 도적다운 모습이 된 걸 보니 정말 기쁘구만. 그럼 이제 자네의 실력을 한 번 점검해 봐야겠지?

yes.0: 실력 점검은 간단해. 옥토퍼스 10마리를 사냥하면 되는 거니까. 뭐 지금까지 상대했던 녀석들보다 훨씬 옥토퍼스가 강하기야 하겠지만... 자네가 지금까지 수련을 열심히 했다면 그리 어렵지 않은 상대일 테니 어서 가서 해치우라고.

no.0: 시험이 두려운 건가? 쯧. 겁쟁이로군. 겁 먹을 필요 없어. 자네가 통과하지 못할 정도로 어려운 과제는 아예 애초부터 안 낼 거니까 말이야.

0.0: Beginner Thief. You've been doing a good job till now. I can see some of your weak points. But you're a Thief now. Let me test you.

yes.0: Checking your progress is simple. All you have to do is hunt #r10 #o2300100#s#k. They're much stronger than the #o1120100#es you have fought, but it shouldn't be too difficult if you have trained properly.

no.0: Are you afraid of the test? Don't be! I wouldn't give you a test that you can't pass!

1.0: You've successfully eliminated 10 #o2300100#s. Hahaha. Very impressive! Just yesterday, you were a rookie... I can't believe how far you've come. Of course, it's the Dark Lord who made all of this possible, right? Haha, I'm very proud.

yes.0: But this is only beginning as a Thief. There is a long way to be a real Thief. The way of Thief...is tough. If you make an effort, you can make it. Be calm and concentrate on your job.

mob.0: You still haven't eliminated all #r10 #o2300100#s#k. Don't be hasty. You will only lose your focus if you rush. Stay calm.
